recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of three men in ornate, embroidered western suits (Nudie-style) against a solid black background, featuring a prominent 1970s-style multiline display typeface at the top and secondary sans-serif text in the bottom corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The three figures form a horizontal line, anchored by the central figure facing forward.
The vibrant, multi-colored embroidery on the suits contrasts sharply with the deep black void.
The large, stacked headline typography mirrors the width of the trio below it.
Warm studio lighting creates soft highlights on the hats and facial features.
coreInvariants: Elaborately decorated western jackets with rhinestones or embroidery
Classic cowboy hats in varying shades
Retro multiline graphic treatment for the primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures positioned mid-ground, waist-up, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the dark blue embroidered suit, looking directly at the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large headline, drops to the central figure, moves laterally to the flanking figures, and ends at the bottom-right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the subjects, emphasizing the colors of the clothing.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White, Red, and Navy (suit base colors) defining the three distinct subjects.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and Orange (typography and embroidery highlights).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the clothing details against a zero-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text features 4-5 parallel internal lines following the glyph contour.
Letters are tightly tracked with a heavy, solid-color drop shadow offset to the bottom-left.
Secondary text is a clean, all-caps geometric sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' and 'N' have sharp, pointed vertices.
The 'D' has a perfectly semicircular bowl.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A complex, decorative headline paired with a minimal, functional sans-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and geometric structure for the multiline modification.
Naturally features the multiline aesthetic common in 70s design.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of three men in 1970s western Nudie suits and cowboy hats against a solid black background. The man on the left wears white, the middle wears navy, and the right wears red. Soft studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, stacked uppercase title at the top using a multiline inline font with a heavy red drop shadow. Add a smaller sans-serif subtitle in the bottom right corner in yellow.

verificationChecks: Does the headline have the characteristic 70s multiline effect?
Are the suits heavily decorated with western motifs?

adjustableVariables: Number of internal lines in font
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean edges on the typography shadow.
Ensure the lighting on the subjects is consistent with a single studio source.
Verify the multiline effect is legible and not blurred.
Confirm the bottom-right text is aligned to the corner margin.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + solid black void + Nudie-style western wear + 1970s multiline display typography.
